Run of `claude/gallant-fermat-rpidl4`, part 1:
- #374 merged (PR #404): `game/run.py W --replay [--speed N] [--from MM:SS]` replays a recorded game. Buildings appear at their command time, chat is `/tellraw` in the player color, ages, research and RESIGN are titles. Sample record at speed 4: 49,984 commands, the server takes 6,336 per second, the timeline needs 75, largest lag 0.28 s.

- #392 merged (PR #406): villagers farm; one farmer per farm, the wheat gets younger, an empty farm is dirt.
- #393 merged (PR #411): `tools/measure_gather.py --resource {wood,food,farm,gold,stone}` and one table row per resource.
- #413 merged (PR #416): each resource has its AoE2 work rate at Normal speed (within 2 % measured).
- Epic #388 (milestone A): all agent criteria are done. New `needs-human` ticket #412: please check the gather game in Minecraft (steps in the ticket).
- This session has no `fire_trigger` tool, so I did not start a fresh run. I continue alone.
- Note: the AoE2 work rates of forager, farmer and miners are the published DE gather rates, not read from `empires2_x2_p1.dat` (not in the cloud). Correct them in #413's place (`gather.AOE2_WORK`) if your `.dat` values differ.

Next: split the `size:L` P2 tickets #394–#398 (game program), then #407.
